verdict.rationale: The record names a housing-subsidy renewal but drops 'municipal', so item 1 is unclear. It retains 'household of three' and 'within program limits'. It never says the renewal is routine. It adds facts the source does not support: an 'Approved' determination, a basis in 'the application on file', and that no resident re-contact is required.
